Question Choices: A matrix has 4 rows and 3 columns. What are its dimensions?
Hints: Dimensions list rows first.|Then list columns.
Solution: An m by n matrix has m rows, n columns and mn entries. Entry a_ij is in row i and column j; row number comes first. Its dimensions are 4 by 3.
